reason: The monoclinic cell is strongly supported by peak positions, but exact recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied; the claimed 0.99738 correlation and approximately 7.18% residual come from a custom fixed-profile forward convolution and leave visible intensity mismatches. More importantly, all three CIFs contain chemically implausible contacts (about 2.10-2.11 A Nd-Nd and 2.22-2.25 A Nd-Sb/Sb-Sb), so the refined coordinates/framework are not physically credible. The alternatives only permute Nd/Sb on the same Pm charge-flip framework, have nearly indistinguishable custom scores, and do not cover materially different symmetry or framework solutions. Thus the cell, and tentatively Z=2/average density topology, have support, while Pm symmetry, coordinates, occupancies, and element ordering remain insufficiently demonstrated; another physically constrained solution and genuine whole-pattern refinement are warranted.
